title: Philippine Declaration of Independence
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Philippine Declaration of Independence", at revision 1376149558, opens: "The Philippine Declaration of Independence was proclaimed by Filipino revolutionary forces general Emilio Aguinaldo on June 12, 1898, in Cavite el Viejo, Philippines. It asserted the sovereignty and independence of the Philippine islands from the 300 years of colonial rule by Spain." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q69772, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "proclamation of independence of the Philippine Islands from the colonial rule of Spain". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
